_comment: Draft answer list (docs/qa/east-asia-oceania.md, 2026-10-16), from general knowledge; run against data/world with check.DATA overridden. Review before trusting. 2026-10-17 review: 'forced': true = restates a config override; 'source' = Wikipedia page for independent entries; '_known_failure' = real, understood bug.

stations._note: OSM has no station named 京都 with train mode: the JR Kyoto station is not a separate object; the train stop of the complex is 近鉄京都 (name_en Kyoto, T1), and 京都 itself is the subway stop (T3). The match uses name_en Kyoto and requires the complex to hold train and subway. Kyoto is in jp.json main_station_re, so this is forced.

stations._known_failure: Kita-Senju is one of the busiest Tokyo stations (Wikipedia source) but scores 26.2 (tier 2), below the tier-1 bar: its platforms are probably under-mapped in OSM; size score only, no config forces it (independent)

JR Kawasaki is one of the busiest JR East stations (Wikipedia source) but scores 41.6 (tier 2), below the tier-1 bar: its platforms are probably under-mapped in OSM; size score only, no config forces it (independent)
